title: Stabilizing Off-policy LLM Optimization with Prefix Importance Ratio
abstract: arXiv:2601.22718v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has increasingly demonstrated strong ability to elicit reasoning behaviors in large language models (LLMs). For training efficiency, rollouts are typically generated in an off-policy manner using an older sampling policy and then used to update the current target policy. To correct the resulting discrepancy between the sampling and target policies, most existing RL objectives rely on a token-level importance sampling ratio. However, we observe unstable training dynamics in existing importance-weighted objectives under large policy lag. In this paper, we revisit LLM policy optimization under off-policy conditions and show that the exact correction for the prefix-marginal policy gradient is the cumulative prefix importance ratio. translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）后训练在激发大语言模型（LLM）的推理行为方面日益展现出强大的能力。为了提高训练效率，通常以离策略的方式使用较旧的采样策略生成rollout样本，然后用于更新当前的目标策略。为了纠正由此产生的采样策略与目标策略之间的偏差，大多数现有的RL目标依赖于token级别的重要性采样比率。然而，我们观察到在较大的策略滞后情况下，现有的重要性加权目标存在训练动态不稳定的问题。在本文中，我们重新审视了离策略条件下的LLM策略优化，并证明了对前缀边缘化策略梯度的精确修正应该是累积前缀重要性比率，而token级别的加权并不能显式地纠正这种前缀分布偏移。为了在大规模离策略漂移下稳定LLM优化，我们提出了一种简单的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现token级别的重要性采样比率无法修正前缀分布偏移，并提出用累积前缀重要性比率对前缀边缘化策略梯度进行精确修正，从而在大策略滞后下稳定大语言模型的离策略强化学习优化。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that token-level importance weighting fails to correct prefix distribution shift, and proposes the cumulative prefix importance ratio as the exact correction for the prefix-marginal policy gradient to stabilize off-policy LLM optimization under large policy lag.
